comparison.objective: Commission and lock a damper vs move and count eleven nuts using a tally counter.
comparison.physical_skill: Precision tool use and mechanical tuning vs repeated nut transfer, counter reset, and one key press per item.
comparison.success_condition: Two repeatable safe impacts with retained setting vs all nuts transferred and the mechanical display correctly reading eleven after reset.
comparison.reason: Counter mechanism actuation and inventory correspondence are unrelated to feedback-driven damper adjustment.
